items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that decodes from random glyphs, left to right, on hover or focus.

items.name: blur-text
items.title: Blur Text
items.description: Words that sharpen out of a blur, one after another, when the text scrolls into view.

items.name: split-text
items.title: Split Text
items.description: Letters that spring into place one by one when the text scrolls into view.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: Text with a soft band of light that sweeps across it on a loop.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types a list of phrases one character at a time, deletes them and moves on, with a blinking caret.

items.name: circular-text
items.title: Circular Text
items.description: Text set evenly around a slowly turning ring, with a slot in the middle for an icon or logo.

items.name: true-focus
items.title: True Focus
items.description: A sentence where one word at a time is sharp, framed by corner brackets that glide from word to word.

items.name: echo-text
items.title: Echo Text
items.description: A headline with trailing copies that fade out behind it, breathe in a slow loop and swing toward the pointer.

items.name: masked-reveal
items.title: Masked Reveal
items.description: A multi-line heading whose lines slide up from behind a mask, then an accent line draws in underneath.

items.name: stroke-text
items.title: Stroke Text
items.description: Outlined text that fills with color on hover or focus, sweeping in from the left, the bottom or the center.

items.name: highlighter-text
items.title: Highlighter Text
items.description: A marker stroke draws behind the words you choose when they scroll into view, with an uneven hand-drawn edge and text that changes color under the pen.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: A call to action that leans toward the pointer and springs back when it leaves.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with a moving glare, then springs back when the pointer leaves.

items.name: click-spark
items.title: Click Spark
items.description: A wrapper that throws short spark lines out of every click inside it.

items.name: ripple-button
items.title: Ripple Button
items.description: A button whose ripple spreads from the exact point that was pressed.

items.name: logo-marquee
items.title: Logo Marquee
items.description: An endless row of logos with faded edges that slows to a stop on hover.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A two-sided card that turns over in 3D on hover or click to show its back.

items.name: glare-hover
items.title: Glare Hover
items.description: A wrapper that sweeps a band of light across its content on hover and on keyboard focus.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: A wrapper that fades, slides, unblurs or scales its content in as it scrolls into view.

items.name: gradual-blur
items.title: Gradual Blur
items.description: A scroll area whose edge melts into a progressive blur that clears when you reach the end.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: Items circling a center on one or more rings, staying upright and showing labels on hover.

items.name: scroll-progress-ring
items.title: Scroll Progress Ring
items.description: A floating ring that shows how far a page has been read and turns into a back-to-top button at the end.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Soft blurred color blobs that drift slowly in two layers, like warm northern lights.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A canvas dot grid where ripples travel out from the pointer, and from random spots when it is idle.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Diagonal meteor streaks with glowing heads, launched at random intervals over a faint starry sky.

items.name: plasma
items.title: Plasma
items.description: A flowing plasma color field that the pointer warps like a lens.

items.name: grainient
items.title: Grainient
items.description: A grainy gradient mesh of up to four colors that slowly morph, with a seed for stable compositions.

items.name: orb
items.title: Orb
items.description: A glowing, breathing energy orb with a swirling surface that brightens and wobbles under the pointer.

items.name: magnet-lines
items.title: Magnet Lines
items.description: A grid of short lines that all turn to face the pointer, and sway in a slow wave when it is away.

items.name: constellation
items.title: Constellation
items.description: Drifting points that connect with lines when they come close, and move gently out of the way of the pointer.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable carousel with momentum snapping, a focused center slide and screen reader announcements.

items.name: bounce-cards
items.title: Bounce Cards
items.description: A fanned hand of cards that bounces in, then lifts a card and pushes its neighbors aside on hover or focus.

items.name: expand-gallery
items.title: Expand Gallery
items.description: A row of tall panels where the hovered or focused one widens to show its title and caption.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: A frosted glass card with a lit rim and a soft shine that follows the pointer, with a solid fallback where blur isn't supported.

items.name: before-after
items.title: Before / After
items.description: A before and after comparison with a divider you drag, tap or move with the arrow keys, side by side or stacked.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tabs with a sliding indicator, panels that follow its direction and full keyboard support.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A compact single-choice control whose thumb slides to the selected option.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: An accessible modal that springs in over a blurred backdrop and hands focus back on close.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open with an animated height, one at a time or several together.

items.name: animated-tooltip
items.title: Animated Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip that springs out of its trigger, leans toward the pointer and shows on focus too.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars that fan out with names on hover, plus a bubble for the rest.

items.name: pill-nav
items.title: Pill Nav
items.description: A pill navbar where the active pill slides between links and a softer pill previews where you point.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: A scrollable list whose rows pop in as they appear, with keyboard selection and edge fades.

items.name: rolling-counter
items.title: Rolling Counter
items.description: An odometer counter whose digits roll the shortest way, with separators, decimals and negatives.

items.name: folder
items.title: Folder
items.description: A folder button that opens on hover or click and fans out papers that lean toward the pointer.

items.name: skeleton-loader
items.title: Skeleton Loader
items.description: Skeleton shapes you compose freely, all lit by one shimmer, that cross-fade into the real content when it loads.

items.name: toggle-switch
items.title: Toggle Switch
items.description: A switch whose knob rides a spring and stretches with its own speed.

items.name: floating-input
items.title: Floating Input
items.description: A text field whose label floats up on focus, with an underline that grows from the center and an error that shakes.

items.name: animated-checkbox
items.title: Animated Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that pops when checked and draws its tick, with an indeterminate dash for partial selections.

items.name: star-rating
items.title: Star Rating
items.description: Stars that fill in a stagger on hover, pop on click and follow the arrow keys.

items.name: xp-bar
items.title: XP Bar
items.description: A level badge and a spring-filled progress bar that bursts when the player levels up.

items.name: pixel-button
items.title: Pixel Button
items.description: A chunky 8-bit button with a hard shadow that physically presses down.

items.name: health-bar
items.title: Health Bar
items.description: An HP bar that drops instantly on a hit while a lighter chip bar trails behind, and glows on heal.
